data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2016 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of $527.577m (opening gross claims outstanding $477.796m). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately $37.3m (c.7.8% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse development/IBNR movements and back-year claims experience particularly in Professional Indemnity and other casualty-related areas; notable current-year large losses (Tullow Oil FPSO, Canadian wildfires) also impacted divisional claims. The report explicitly records a net deterioration on prior year claims (net $7.197m), while the gross triangle shows the larger gross strengthening reported here. Management attributes the deterioration to IBNR movement and disappointing performance in certain PI sub-classes.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet 'Claims Outstanding' prior year column (2015) and converted from $000 to millions. Prior-year development gross amount was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 39-40) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2008-2014; the report only explicitly states a NET deterioration ($7.197m), not a gross prior-year movement. Gross PYD therefore is derived and rounded to three decimals; confidence set to 0.8. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
